summary: A highly professional technical blog and portfolio for senior engineering and DevSecOps writing. It will publish local README and Markdown content first, with a planned path to import articles from Hashnode, Dev.to, and freeCodeCamp with source attribution and canonical redirects.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace contains only a README, LICENSE, and a legacy Python-oriented .gitignore; no runnable application or framework is present.

questions.question: Describe the features for Technical Blog and Portfolio.
questions.answer: Editorial homepage and portfolio; article index, tags, search, RSS, sitemap, syntax highlighting, accessible responsive typography, local README/Markdown publishing, article metadata, source attribution, canonical URLs and redirect metadata for future Hashnode, Dev.to, and freeCodeCamp imports.
questions.rationale: Features are distilled from the requested technical blog, portfolio, local Markdown publishing, and future cross-platform article synchronization workflow.
questions.recommendedChoice: Editorial homepage and portfolio; article index, tags, search, RSS, sitemap, syntax highlighting, accessible responsive typography, local README/Markdown publishing, article metadata, source attribution, canonical URLs and redirect metadata for future Hashnode, Dev.to, and freeCodeCamp imports.
